newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Millennium switch to cost Belgium 19 bln bfr.
newsitem.headline: Millennium switch to cost Belgium 19 bln bfr.

text.p: Adapting computer systems to the millennium change will cost Belgian companies and public authorities at least 19 billion francs ($538.9 million), Economy Minister Elio di Rupo said in a statement on Wednesday.
He said a poll among public administrations and professional organisations showed that many groups were not yet adequately prepared to switch their computers to the year 2000.
Many existing computer systems only use two digits to indicate the year, in order to save computer memory.
Di Rupo said the total cost would be much higher, as the estimate was based only on partial replies from the federations.
